text:
Dana K: heads-up — p99 on /embeddings-dev jumped to 2.4s in the dashboard but p50/p95 look normal. anyone seen this pattern before?
Omar V: saw a similar spike last month. often caused by mixing histogram-backed rollups with raw sample percentiles.
Priya S: what makes them mix? our rollup pipeline labels sources but dashboard merges by endpoint only.
Dana K: yes. the endpoint view collapses sample_source tag. so direct-client histograms (high fidelity) get merged with proxy-sampled raw points (sparser).
metrics-bot: query run: SELECT count(), p50,p95,p99(latency_ms) BY sample_source FROM latency_rollups WHERE endpoint='/embeddings-dev' AND ts BETWEEN 1812342000 AND 1812345600
Priya S: results: sample_source=direct count=1200 p99=190ms; sample_source=proxy count=6 p99=2400ms
Omar V: proxy samples are tiny and yield unstable p99 that pollutes the merged percentile. dashboard nearest-rank implementation takes combined samples -> blows up.
Dana K: temp fix: show sample origin badges and prevent merging unless sample_source matches. Long term: weighted-percentile that respects provenance or only present blended percentiles when each source has >N samples.
Priya S: agree. also add a small visual cue when p99 is calculated from <1% of total samples. users assume p99 reflects bulk traffic when it doesn't.
Omar V: also check if any route_variants (quantized vs fp16) are being merged. different model variants have different latency distributions and should be separate by default in the endpoint breakdown.
Dana K: action items: 1) Priya -> quick console patch to surface sample_source badge and gray out p99 when contributor samples <30 2) Omar -> infra ticket to change rollup merge rules and propose weighted merge + provenance-aware aggregation 3) Dana -> notify customer success for endpoints that will show changed numbers
metrics-bot: patch deployed to staging behind flag feature.samples_provenance
Priya S: PR open: console#4123, includes tooltip "p99 computed from N samples across M sources"
Dana K: thanks. let's monitor for regressions after the flag flip. if p99 still spiky, we'll dig into proxy sampling rate.
Omar V: FYI, I'll add tests to the rollup pipeline ensuring percentiles are deterministic for small sample counts.
Dana K: perfect — closing for now.
